Start: Sphinx's Tutelage (battlefield); Opposition Agent (battlefield); Mana Severance (hand); Hive Mind (battlefield); Painter's Servant (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Any color chosen with Painter's Servant.
Steps: Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}.
  Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Mana Severance.
  Resolve each opponent's Mana Severance, exiling all lands from their libraries.
  Resolve your Mana Severance, choosing not to exile any lands from your library.
  The next time you draw a card, Sphinx's Tutelage triggers, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
  Because Painter's Servant will force the cards to share a color, and they will not be lands due to the opponent having no lands in their library, Sphinx's Tutelage will continue to repeat the process until the opponent's library is empty.

  Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Urza from the battlefield to your hand.

## Combo 479-1494-1561-3365
Cards: Triskaidekaphile + Peer into the Abyss + Aeromoeba + Sage of Hours
Color identity: UB | Bracket: 2+ (Core) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {4}{B}{B}{B}
Produces: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep
Start: Triskaidekaphile (battlefield); Peer into the Abyss (hand); Aeromoeba (battlefield); Sage of Hours (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Sage of Hours has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
  You have at least 26 cards in library.
  You have at least 2 life.
Steps: Cast Peer into the Abyss, drawing at least twelve cards and losing half your life total.
  Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, gaining an extra turn for every five counters removed.
  Activate Aeromeba by discarding a card to switch Aeromeba's power and toughness until end of turn.
  Repeat step 3 until you have exactly thirteen cards in your hand.
  Pass to the extra turn.
  At the beginning of your upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, winning the game.

Color identity: UB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 4 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {2}{B}{B}
Produces: Infinite black mana; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite self-mill; Put all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard and library into your hand; Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite death triggers; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite storm count
Start: Kairi, the Swirling Sky (battlefield); Sacrifice (hand); Saw in Half (hand); Sakashima the Impostor (battlefield: as a copy of Kairi)
Steps: Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Sakashima the Impostor and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
  When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it triggers.
  Holding priority, cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Sakashima the Impostor tokens.
  When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
  Resolve Sacrifice, adding six {B}.
  Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
  Repeat
Notes: You can forego casting Sacrifice if you have enough black mana. This'll allow you to net creature tokens. The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

## Combo 628-728-1636-2838
Cards: Mikaeus, the Unhallowed + Intruder Alarm + Grimgrin, Corpse-Born + Soul Diviner
Color identity: UB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 6 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite card draw; Near-infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Near-infinite untap of all creatures; Infinite draw triggers; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Near-infinite death triggers
Start: Mikaeus, the Unhallowed (battlefield); Intruder Alarm (battlefield); Grimgrin, Corpse-Born (battlefield); Soul Diviner (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Soul Diviner doesn't have summoning sickness.
  You control another nontoken non-Human creature that doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it or enter with +1/+1 counters on it.
Steps: Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the additional creature
  When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
  When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
  Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Activate Soul Diviner by tapping it and removing the +1/+1 counter from the additional creature, causing you to draw a card.
  Repeat

Start: Zellix, Sanity Flayer (battlefield); Intruder Alarm (battlefield); Phenax, God of Deception (battlefield)
